description: Work out 2026 federal quarterly estimated tax payments with the IRS safe harbor rules (90% of this year's tax or 100%/110% of last year's), minus withholding, with the four due dates. Same math as the auracalcs.com quarterly estimated tax calculator. Estimate only.

expectedTax2026.description: Expected total 2026 tax: federal income tax plus self-employment tax. calculate_1099_tax can estimate it.

paymentsMade.description: Estimated payments already made for 2026. Defaults to 0.

priorYearAgiOver150k.description: Was 2025 AGI over $150,000 ($75,000 if married filing separately)? Then the prior-year safe harbor is 110%. Defaults to false.

priorYearTax2025.description: Total tax on the 2025 return (Form 1040 line 24). Use 0 only if 2025 had no tax liability and was a full 12-month year.

withholding.description: Federal tax withheld from W-2 jobs in 2026. Defaults to 0.

name: calculate_quarterly_estimated_tax
title: Plan 2026 quarterly estimated tax
